subject: a narrow back lane behind the houses of a small fantasy town
camera: The camera stands at eye level (1.6 m) in a lane about three metres wide, running along the backs of the houses of the packed quarter. A high plaster wall is close on the right.

bearings.ahead: the lane running on, narrowing, the plaster walls closing in until only a slot of light is left, then turning a corner out of sight; washing lines strung between upper storeys across it
bearings.right: the back wall of the quarter rising close and high: pale lime plaster over dark oak framing, one shuttered upper window, firewood stacked against the wall, a water butt under a downpipe
bearings.behind: the lane running back the other way and out into a cobbled square about forty metres across, bright at the end of the slot
bearings.left: lower outbuildings and garden walls on the other side of the lane, their steep dark blue-grey slate roofs at head height, a wooden gate, hens
bearings.up: a narrow strip of sky between the eaves, crossed by washing lines with sheets and shirts hanging still
bearings.down: packed earth and broken cobbles worn into a shallow drainage channel down the middle, a puddle against the wall
